candidates.source_name: EKR - Elektronikus Közbeszerzési Rendszer (portal)
candidates.why_relevant: Legally mandated national e-procurement platform (operational since 2018, Kbt. + 424/2017 Korm. rendelet). All Hungarian contracting authority procedures — including bank account management, card acceptance/POS, cash handling and core-banking IT — are conducted and documented here. Primary spine for A2 tender/award intelligence.
candidates.access_status: public front-end; full document access and bidding require registration
candidates.legal_status: official government system; public notices are public data (közérdekű adat)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled crawl of the public procedure/notice search with CPV filters (66110000 banking, 66172000 payment transaction processing, 30144200 ticket-issuing/POS-adjacent, 48000000 IT); render-capable fetcher (JS portal), polite rate, retry on maintenance windows
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from Közbeszerzési Hatóság and Wikipedia HU
queries_used: EKR ekr.gov.hu Elektronikus Közbeszerzési Rendszer közbeszerzés bankszámla-vezetés ajánlati felhívás
EKR eljárás kereső nyilvános eljárások CPV 66110000
candidates.observed_blocker: Fetch of https://ekr.gov.hu/portal/kozbeszerzes/eljarasok/ returned a Hungarian maintenance page ('Sajnáljuk, a rendszeren karbantartást végzünk'). Treated as a hypothesis, not a verdict — EKR is a live mandatory system; retry outside scheduled full-refresh windows (see https://ujvilag.gov.hu/ekr/rendszerinformaciok/tervezett-teljes-frissitesek).

candidates.source_name: Közbeszerzési Értesítő (Public Procurement Bulletin) - Közbeszerzési Hatóság
candidates.why_relevant: Official gazette of the Public Procurement Authority publishing every domestic notice: ajánlati/ajánlattételi felhívás, tájékoztató az eljárás eredményéről (award notice), szerződésmódosítás, teljesítés. Below-EU-threshold banking/payments contracts appear here and nowhere else.
candidates.access_status: open, free; per-issue signed PDF plus HTML notice search
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily harvest of issue PDFs via the stable pattern https://www.kozbeszerzes.hu/media/issue/pdf/signed/KE-YYYY-NN_.pdf plus the structured notice search endpoint; PDF text extraction then keyword/CPV filtering
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + direct fetch of the Értesítő landing page
queries_used: Közbeszerzési Értesítő eredménytájékoztató kártyaelfogadás POS terminál
önkormányzat számlavezetési szolgáltatás közbeszerzés eredménytájékoztató hirdetmény bank 2025

candidates.source_name: Közbeszerzési Hatóság - Hirdetmény adatbázis (structured notice search)
candidates.why_relevant: Field-level searchable notice database behind the Értesítő — filter by contracting authority, notice type, CPV and date. The most collection-friendly entry point for systematic banking/payments CPV sweeps.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Parameterised query crawl per CPV and per quarter; capture result lists then dereference each notice detail page
queries_used: Közbeszerzési Hatóság adatbázis hirdetmény kereső

candidates.source_name: CoRe - Szerződésnyilvántartó rendszer (public contract register), publikus kereső
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory register of public procurement CONTRACTS concluded since 1 Jan 2018, with contract text, value, parties and modifications. Turns award notices into actual contract terms/values for banking and payment-services deals — the layer notices alone do not give.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query public search by contracting authority and subject keywords (számlavezetés, kártyaelfogadás, készpénzszállítás); download contract PDFs where exposed
queries_used: Közbeszerzési Hatóság adatbázis szerződések nyilvántartása CoRe hirdetmény kereső
candidates.observed_blocker: kereso.core.kt.hu is http-only in the cited reference; scheme/host may have moved — treat as unverified.

candidates.source_name: KBA - Közbeszerzési Adatbázis (legacy pre-2018 procedures and contracts)
candidates.why_relevant: Historical archive of procedures and contracts before the EKR/CoRe cut-over (pre-2018). Needed to reconstruct multi-cycle history of bank account-management and card-acceptance mandates, which typically run on 3-5 year cycles.
candidates.access_status: public Oracle APEX interface; session-id URLs, awkward to crawl
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Session-aware scripted browsing of the APEX app; one-off backfill rather than continuous monitoring
queries_used: Közbeszerzési Hatóság adatbázis szerződések nyilvántartása CoRe hirdetmény kereső
candidates.observed_blocker: APEX session ids embedded in URL make deep links unstable; unverified.

candidates.source_name: Hirdetményfigyelő (official Authority notice-alert service)
candidates.why_relevant: Official saved-search/alerting layer on the Értesítő. Lets the intelligence programme receive push notification of new banking/payments notices instead of relying on polling, with authoritative provenance.
candidates.legal_status: official service; ToS apply to account use
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Create a monitored account with CPV/keyword saved searches; ingest resulting e-mail alerts into the pipeline
queries_used: Közbeszerzési Hatóság online szolgáltatásai hirdetményfigyelő

candidates.source_name: Közbeszerzési Döntőbizottság - döntőbizottsági és bírósági határozatok kereső
candidates.why_relevant: Remedy-body and court decisions on contested procurements. Reveals competitive dynamics invisible in notices: who challenged a bank-account or POS tender, on what grounds, disqualifications, annulled awards, and specification disputes.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic keyword search (bank, számlavezetés, kártyaelfogadás, POS, készpénz) over decision full text; store decision PDFs
queries_used: Közbeszerzési Döntőbizottság határozatok kereső kozbeszerzes.hu jogorvoslat adatbázis

candidates.source_name: Nyilvántartott ajánlatkérők (register of contracting authorities)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative actor map: the full list of entities legally obliged to procure under Kbt. Used to build the target universe (ministries, municipalities, state holdings, utilities) whose banking/payments contracts must eventually be tendered.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off scrape then quarterly refresh; join to notice data by authority name/tax id
queries_used: Közbeszerzési Hatóság adatbázisok

candidates.source_name: Minősített ajánlattevők jegyzéke (qualified bidders list)
candidates.why_relevant: Supply-side map: which vendors are pre-qualified to bid. Combined with Kizárt ajánlattevők (excluded bidders) and Szerződésszegések (contract breaches) it profiles the competitive field around payments/IT contracts.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic scrape; cross-reference with award winners
queries_used: Közbeszerzési Hatóság adatbázisok

candidates.source_name: TED - Tenders Electronic Daily (Hungary, above-threshold notices)
candidates.why_relevant: All Hungarian procurements above EU thresholds are also published in the OJEU supplement. TED offers structured eForms XML, bulk downloads and a search API — often the cleanest machine-readable route to the same HU banking/payments notices carried by the Értesítő.
candidates.access_status: open; bulk XML packages via registered access/FTP
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Search API / daily+monthly XML packages filtered on country=HU and CPV 661*, 6617*, 7220*, 4800*, 3014*
queries_used: TED tenders electronic daily Hungary notice banking services 66110000 award notice API

candidates.source_name: KEF Központosított Közbeszerzési Portál (kozbeszerzes.gov.hu)
candidates.why_relevant: KEF is the designated central purchasing body for government institutions; framework agreements (keretmegállapodás) it signs cover IT, telecom and office categories that can carry payment-terminal, cash-handling and banking-IT scope. Institutions buy through this portal rather than running their own tenders — a major channel that would be missed by watching EKR alone.
candidates.access_status: public front pages; institution area requires login
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the framework-agreement/news sections and the product-category listings; cross-check against Értesítő notices for the underlying KM procedures
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles (who else must publish/aggregate) + local-language search
queries_used: Közbeszerzési és Ellátási Főigazgatóság KEF központosított közbeszerzés keretmegállapodás portál kef.gov.hu

candidates.source_name: DKÜ Zrt. - Digitális Kormányzati Ügynökség, IT procurement portal (IDPR)
candidates.why_relevant: DKÜ holds exclusive competence over state IT procurement (301/2018 Korm. rendelet; unified IDPR portal since 1 Jan 2025, reinforced by 467-468/2025 decrees). Core-banking IT, payment software and terminal-related state purchases route through DKÜ framework agreements, making it a second mandatory choke point alongside EKR.
candidates.access_status: public info pages plus közérdekű adatok section; transactional portal gated
candidates.legal_status: state-owned company, statutory mandate; public-interest data published
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor dkuzrt.hu news + közérdekű adatok (contract disclosures) and the kozbeszerzes.dkuzrt.hu framework listings
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles (who regulates/channels IT buying) + local-language search

candidates.source_name: OpenTender.eu - Hungary dataset (Government Transparency Institute)
candidates.why_relevant: Cleaned, structured OCDS-style dataset combining TED with the Hungarian national portal, explicitly including below-EU-threshold Hungarian contracts. candidates.legal_status: open data, check licence per dataset
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Bulk download of HU dataset; treat as secondary/derived — always re-anchor conclusions to the primary Értesítő/EKR notice

negative_findings.description: Direct fetch of the EKR public procedure listing (https://ekr.gov.hu/portal/kozbeszerzes/eljarasok/) returned a Hungarian maintenance notice rather than content.
negative_findings.result_summary: Maintenance page 'Sajnáljuk, a rendszeren karbantartást végzünk' with a pointer to ujvilag.gov.hu planned-refresh schedule. Recorded as unverified, NOT as dead — EKR is a legally mandatory live system.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The primary cell source could not be inspected directly in this pass, so its exact search-URL patterns, CPV filter parameters and pagination behaviour remain unmapped; the collector design must be validated against the live system.

negative_findings.description: No documented public API or bulk-download endpoint was found for the Közbeszerzési Értesítő / kozbeszerzes.hu notice database.
negative_findings.result_summary: The Értesítő landing page exposes only HTML search, saved-search alerting and per-issue signed PDFs (pattern https://www.kozbeszerzes.hu/media/issue/pdf/signed/KE-YYYY-NN_.pdf). No API documentation surfaced in hu or en searches.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: National-only (below-EU-threshold) banking/payments notices — likely the majority of municipal account-management and POS contracts — must be obtained by HTML/PDF harvesting or via TED-derived third-party datasets, raising fragility and parsing cost.

negative_findings.description: No individual Hungarian banking/payments tender or award notice (e.g. a specific bankszámla-vezetés or kártyaelfogadás contract) was retrieved and confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language searches for 'számlavezetési szolgáltatás közbeszerzés eredménytájékoztató' returned only the Értesítő issue PDFs generically, not a resolvable individual notice.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the finding that HU notice content is locked inside daily PDFs and JS search UIs rather than being individually indexed by web search — the collection pipeline cannot rely on search engines and must query the registers directly.

negative_findings.description: Red Flags (redflags.eu) risk-monitoring tool for Hungarian procurement is reported as not updated since 27 October 2023.
negative_findings.result_summary: Cause given is a change of the TED data source; the site remains up as a historical corpus.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ruling it out as a live signal prevents building a monitoring dependency on a dead feed; its historical corpus and red-flag methodology remain reusable.

negative_findings.description: The main Hungarian tender-monitoring vendors (tender-ertesito.hu, khf.hu, kozbeszerzesmonitor.hu, napitender.hu, innotender.hu) are subscription-gated.
negative_findings.result_summary: All advertise paid subscriptions (some with trials); none disclosed an open API or data-export terms permitting redistribution.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These cannot be scraped and must be treated as licensed cross-checks; budgeting or a licensing decision is needed if completeness assurance is required.

negative_findings.description: The CoRe contract register public search was cited only as http://kereso.core.kt.hu, and the legacy KBA database uses Oracle APEX session-id URLs.
negative_findings.result_summary: Neither endpoint was inspected in this pass; deep links may be unstable or migrated.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Contract-level values and pre-2018 history are the two layers most likely to break silently in a collector; they need explicit endpoint verification before being scheduled.

coverage_gaps.description: The exact CPV code set for Hungarian banking/payments procurement was not empirically validated against live notices (only 66110000 banking services was confirmed conceptually).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Once EKR/Értesítő search is reachable, run an empirical CPV frequency analysis over HU notices containing bank/payment keywords to derive the real code set (66100000/66110000 banking, 66172000 payment transaction processing, 79940000 collection agency, 30144200 ticket-issuing machines, 30230000/48000000 IT, 79710000 security/cash-in-transit) and freeze it as the collection filter.

coverage_gaps.description: Special-sector (közszolgáltatói / utilities) contracting entities — energy, water, transport operators — procure banking and card-acceptance services under a distinct Kbt. regime; this pass did not separately map their notice practices beyond one incidental example (BKV).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated sweep of közszolgáltatói ajánlatkérők notices and their own 'beszerzések / nem közbeszerzés' pages, which carry high-volume ticketing and POS acceptance contracts.

coverage_gaps.description: Hungarian central-government institutions largely bank through the Magyar Államkincstár (State Treasury) rather than tendering commercial accounts; this exemption boundary was not verified in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Determine which entity classes are Treasury-mandated versus free to tender commercial bank accounts (municipalities, state-owned companies, foundations/universities), so the addressable tender universe is not overstated. Sources to check: allamkincstar.gov.hu and Áht./Kbt. provisions.

coverage_gaps.description: Annual közbeszerzési terv (procurement plan) publications — which precede notices by months — were identified only generically via buyer-side pages, not as a systematically collectable set.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm whether procurement plans are centrally published in EKR (they are prepared there per the system description) and, if so, add a dedicated plan-harvest job; otherwise crawl buyer sites each Q1.

coverage_gaps.description: EKR and the Közbeszerzési Értesítő publish almost exclusively in Hungarian; only TED provides English versions, and only for above-threshold notices.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Design the pipeline as Hungarian-first with machine translation at the analysis layer; do not rely on English keyword filters, which would silently drop most below-threshold banking/payments contracts.

coverage_gaps.description: Purchases made under KEF and DKÜ framework agreements (call-offs) may not generate individual EKR notices, making a material share of state payments/IT spend invisible to notice-only monitoring.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Map the call-off disclosure rules for KEF (kozbeszerzes.gov.hu) and DKÜ (IDPR / kozbeszerzes.dkuzrt.hu), and add contract-level collection via CoRe to recover the spend that framework call-offs hide.

brief: Hungary's public-sector banking/payments procurement has an unusually clean primary spine: EKR (ekr.gov.hu) is the legally mandatory platform where every Kbt. procedure is run, and the Közbeszerzési Értesítő on kozbeszerzes.hu is the official gazette publishing all resulting notices, backed by a structured hirdetmény search, the CoRe contract register (post-2018), the legacy KBA archive (pre-2018) and the Döntőbizottság remedy-decision database. Above-threshold notices are duplicated on TED in structured eForms XML, which is by far the most machine-readable route, while below-threshold banking, POS and cash-handling contracts exist only in Hungarian-language HTML search results and daily signed PDF issues with no public API — the central collection challenge for this cell. Two mandatory central purchasing channels sit beside EKR and would be missed by notice-only monitoring: KEF (kozbeszerzes.gov.hu) for government framework agreements and DKÜ Zrt. for state IT procurement, whose framework call-offs surface mainly at contract level. A commercial monitoring layer (tender-ertesito.hu, khf.hu, kozbeszerzesmonitor.hu) and an open-data layer (OpenTender HU, the now-stale Red Flags) are useful cross-checks but are derived sources and subscription- or licence-constrained; EKR itself returned a maintenance page during this pass and remains unverified rather than unavailable.
